Moose (Japanese: ムース Moose) is one of the characters from Giratina and the Sky Warrior. He is the husband of .

==In the movies==
Moose was accompanying his wife to deliver a bouquet of Gracideas to his wife's great-grandmother for her hundredth birthday. On a train they met up with , , , , Sylvan, Shun, Taka, and . He told them that he used to hike a lot and witnessed 's flower bearing once before. Shortly after, he watched Shaymin transform into its Sky Forme. Following this, the train was attacked by Zero's , and , but Ash, Dawn, and Shaymin were able to drive them off.

He later said his goodbyes to Ash, his friends, and Shaymin as they set off on a ferry to the flower garden of , but met up with them again some time later, when Ash and his friends visited Layla's great-grandmother's birthday party.
